instruction.name: xvmod.w
instruction.description: Compute the remainder of each signed 32-bit element in `a` divided by the corresponding element in `b`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4

latencies.notes: xj -> result chain. The measured operand pair is a sample; the range comes from the operand sweep recorded for this instruction.

throughput.notes: Range over the same pairs: min CPI 4.50 at 0/1, max CPI 15.50 at 2147483647/1. Sample uses 1/1.

notes: LASX variable-latency integer divide/modulo. Latency uses an element-0 reset helper; throughput uses 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover positive operands including powers of two and max values. Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
